about_short_description.short_description: Reframe is an app to help people cut back on alcohol use and build healthier habits

product.name: Reframe App
product.description: A neuroscience-based app that provides an evidence-based program to help users reduce alcohol consumption and build healthier habits.

product.name: Liquid Luck
product.description: A non-alcoholic beverage formulated to reduce alcohol cravings and support brain health and mood stabilization.

product.name: Evidence-Based Alcohol Reduction Program
product.description: A structured program based on neuroscience and psychology to help users change their alcohol-related habits.

product.name: Personalized Drink Tracker
product.description: A tool within the app that allows users to monitor their daily alcohol consumption and track progress over time.

product.name: On-Demand Courses
product.description: Recorded and live video classes covering topics related to alcohol reduction and building a meaningful life without alcohol.

product.name: 24/7 Private, Anonymous Community
product.description: An online community within the app where users can connect anonymously for support, share milestones, and engage with specialized groups.
